Why GrowClickers

Marketing Is Only One Part of Business Growth.

Running ads is not growth. Real business growth requires clear positioning, a strong brand, the right audience, an effective offer, and a structured marketing system that works together.

Clear Positioning

Know exactly where your business stands in the market.

Strong Brand

A brand that creates trust and communicates your value.

Right Audience

Reaching the people who actually need what you offer.

Effective Offer

A compelling offer that converts interest into action.

Marketing System

A structured system that generates leads consistently.

Our Methodology

The GrowClickers Growth System

A structured five-step process that takes your business from where it is to where it needs to be.

01 Build02 Brand03 Launch04 Optimise05 Scale
01
Build

We start by deeply understanding your business — your goals, target audience, market position, competition, and current challenges. This forms the foundation of everything we do.

  • Business & market analysis
  • Competitor research
  • Audience mapping
  • Goal alignment
02
Brand

We develop or refine your brand identity, positioning, value proposition, and communication strategy so your business stands out and communicates clearly.

  • Brand positioning
  • Value proposition
  • Visual identity direction
  • Communication strategy
03
Launch

We execute marketing strategies through the most relevant channels for your business — campaigns, creative content, and advertising built for real results.

  • Campaign strategy
  • Ad creative & copy
  • Multi-channel execution
  • Content creation
04
Optimise

We continuously review campaign performance, lead quality, cost efficiency, and marketing data to improve results and eliminate what isn't working.

  • Performance analysis
  • Lead quality review
  • Cost optimisation
  • Data-driven decisions
05
Scale

We identify what is working and build on it — scaling successful strategies and exploring new sustainable growth opportunities for your business.

  • Scaling winning campaigns
  • New channel exploration
  • Growth opportunity mapping
  • Long-term planning

The Founder

Built Through Experience. Driven by Growth.

GrowClickers was founded by Shafi Pulakkad, a performance marketer and business growth strategist based in Kerala, India.

With hands-on experience in managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns across multiple industries, Shafi built GrowClickers to offer businesses something beyond typical agency work — a genuine growth partnership built on strategy, transparency, and real results.

The same experience that drives client campaigns now powers GrowClickers Academy, where Shafi personally mentors students in performance marketing through practical, real-world learning.
